name: Chuncheon

routes.outcome: Official Chuncheon 생활공간정보 public map found and loaded.
Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It posts to /GMT_Map/getLoaction.json, uses EPSG:5186 map coordinates, and configures an anonymous GMT_proxy WFS route for vector layers.
Current map metadata returned Chuncheon map sequence 156, extent/center in projected coordinates, zoom 8-19; this is map configuration, not parcel geometry.
Current layer metadata returned 138 layers. It includes the group label 춘천시 지적 and a Kakao cadastral-editing tile layer, but no Chuncheon parcel feature layer with a safe native identity was exposed.
Anonymous public layer-list request for map sequence 156 returned background/overlay layers; the response did not provide parcel polygons or parcel attributes.

Exact WUP point was used without shifting, in a bounded administrative lookup request; response was empty because the endpoint expects the viewer's EPSG:5186 coordinate space. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Official national K-GeoP public viewer found; its visible workflow includes 일필지정보 (one-parcel information). No Chuncheon parcel geometry was retained from it.
Official Chuncheon page identifies 토지정보과 and publishes administrative land/cadastral statistics. This is local custodian evidence, not a parcel geometry API.
